title.zh: 修正 Gold 3 v1 SmartPay5 结算

purpose.en: Correct SmartPay5 receipt reconciliation, concurrent renewal, and administrator identity for production settlement.
purpose.zh: 修正生产结算中的 SmartPay5 回执对账、并发续期与管理员身份。

en: Decode the contract's internal TransactionID from a confirmed receipt before subscription claim.
Trust only an active Clerk user's exact primary email when bridging a web session.
zh: 从已确认回执解码合约内部 TransactionID 后再认领订阅。
桥接网页会话时仅信任未封禁、未锁定 Clerk 用户的精确主邮箱。

en: Crypto verification, SmartPay5 claims and records, subscription renewal, and administrator payment tools.
zh: 影响加密付款核验、SmartPay5 认领与记录、订阅续期及管理员付款工具。

en: Use a claim-gated atomic upsert for cumulative, replay-safe subscription periods.
Require fresh verified Clerk primary-email ownership for the permanent administrator without coupling it to a legacy local ID.
zh: 使用受认领状态约束的原子更新，安全累加订阅期限并防止重放。
永久管理员必须即时验证当前 Clerk 主邮箱所有权，且不与旧本地 ID 耦合。

en: Run receipt decoding, future-block confirmation, bounded-body/RPC ordering, full administrator-entry enumeration, legacy-ID admin, leap-boundary calendar renewal, replay, protected-navigation, repository test, lint, and build gates.
zh: 运行回执解码、未来区块确认数、有界请求与 RPC 顺序、全部管理员入口枚举、旧 ID 管理员、闰年边界日历续期、防重放、受保护导航、仓库测试、lint 与构建门禁。

en: No contract, payment configuration, translation dictionary, classroom feature, header, footer, or production content is changed; no real payment is submitted.
zh: 不修改合约、付款配置、翻译词典、课堂功能、页头、页脚或生产内容；不提交真实付款。

en: Preserve GreatLoveMeta branding, 22-language interface, site-owned infrastructure, and existing products and data.
zh: 保留 GreatLoveMeta 品牌、22 语言界面、站点独立基础设施及现有产品与数据。
